name: Whirlpool S.A.
summary: Whirlpool S.A. manufactures, sells, import, and exports home appliances in Brazil. The company offers refrigerators, freezers, refrigerator-freezers, air conditioners, ice makers, stoves, dishwashers, garbage disposals and compactors, trash compactors, and vacuum cleaners.
